source_review: The private ScrollPointer track length is now usize. Windowed press, track click and drag derive it from the same window.logical_rows used by painting; prepare also applies that logical viewport. Public legacy u16 prepare/handle signatures remain unchanged and no-window callers retain that fallback.

The drag mapping uses saturating usize addition/subtraction from the descriptor source row rather than a narrowing signed conversion. The physical/source descriptor remains the sole mapping; no second scroll state or grab cache was added.

Legacy draw delegates to a full window and retains canonical theme resolution. Modern per-part window callback precedence, complete legacy part handling and bounded unsupported-part diagnostics remain intact.

Non-exhaustive Diagnostic gained an additive variant through the existing bounded store. Runtime/editor input queue, focus policy, scope lifecycle and actual cursor-retention code are not changed by this source diff.
